Function, is an experimental framework used to

measure how much a large language model alters the meaning of specific terms or text inputs during generation. 2

Developed by researcher Lee Sharks (writing under

the heteronym Nobel Glas), the principle treats meaning as a "field deformation”. It tracks how context or Al processing shifts a term's original definition. Key aspects of this research program include: @ Academia.edu
